changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill.
- Adds daily automated updates for OpenClaw and all installed skills via a scheduled cron job.
- Sends a summary message after updates, detailing what changed.
- Supports configuration of update time, timezone, and summary message destination.
- Provides troubleshooting steps and manual commands for update management.
